FROM yearmonth
JOIN customers ON yearmonth.customerid = customers.customerid
WHERE customers.currency = 'EUR' AND customers.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
GROUP BY segment
HAVING ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN date = '2013' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN date = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 2) = (SELECT MAX(increase) FROM (SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN date = '2013' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN date = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 2) AS increase

OR ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN date = '2013' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN date = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 2) = (SELECT MIN(increase) FROM (SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN date = '2013' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN date = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 2) AS increase

GROUP BY segment) AS min_increase;

ROUND(AVG(COUNT(a.account_id)) OVER () FILTER (WHERE d.a2 = 'Central Bohemia'), 2) AS three_district_avg,

SELECT segment, ROUND(increase_percentage::numeric, 2) AS increase_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT segment, 
           (SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2013-01-01' AND date < '2014-01-01' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
            SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2012-01-01' AND date < '2013-01-01' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)) / 
           NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2012-01-01' AND date < '2013-01-01' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 AS increase_percentage
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'EUR' AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY segment
) AS subquery
WHERE increase_percentage = (SELECT MAX(increase_percentage) FROM (
    SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2013-01-01' AND date < '2014-01-01' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
            SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2012-01-01' AND date < '2013-01-01' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)) / 
           NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2012-01-01' AND date < '2013-01-01' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 AS increase_percentage
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'EUR' AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY segment
) AS inner_subquery)
OR increase_percentage = (SELECT MIN(increase_percentage) FROM (
    SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2013-01-01' AND date < '2014-01-01' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
            SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2012-01-01' AND date < '2013-01-01' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END)) / 
           NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2012-01-01' AND date < '2013-01-01' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 AS increase_percentage
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid
    WHERE c.currency = 'EUR' AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY segment
) AS inner_subquery);

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone FROM member AS m JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT m.link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id JOIN member AS m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY m.link_to_major HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(attendee_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS attendee_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id JOIN member AS m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY m.link_to_major) AS subquery) ORDER BY m.link_to_major;

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(ma.major_id) FILTER (WHERE m.link_to_major IS NULL) * 100.0) / COUNT(ma.major_id), 2) AS percentage_no_members FROM major AS ma LEFT JOIN member AS m ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major;

SELECT sh.full_name FROM superhero AS sh INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON sh.id = ha.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength' AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute AS ha2 INNER JOIN attribute AS a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'strength');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) FROM hero_power hp INNER JOIN superhero sh ON hp.hero_id = sh.id WHERE hp.power_id IN (SELECT hp2.power_id FROM hero_power hp2 INNER JOIN superhero sh2 ON hp2.hero_id = sh2.id WHERE sh2.id IN (SELECT sh3.id FROM superhero sh3 INNER JOIN hero_power hp3 ON sh3.id = hp3.hero_id WHERE hp3.power_id = (SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE power_name = 'Super Strength'))) GROUP BY hp.power_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sh.id) > 0;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 1) FROM superhero WHERE race_id = (SELECT race_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') AND height_cm IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS average_weight FROM superhero s INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute a ON a.id = hp.power_id WHERE s.alignment_id = (SELECT id FROM attribute WHERE attribute_name = 'Bad') AND s.skin_colour_id = (SELECT id FROM attribute WHERE attribute_name = 'Green') AND hp.power_id = (SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE power_name = 'Flight') AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) FROM superhero WHERE id IN (SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id FROM hero_power hp JOIN superhero s ON hp.hero_id = s.id WHERE hp.power_id IN (SELECT power_id FROM hero_power WHERE hero_id = (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')) AND s.id <> (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')) AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(lab_dates.count), 2) AS avg_lab_dates, p.sex FROM patient AS p LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(date) AS count FROM laboratory GROUP BY id) AS lab_dates ON lab_dates.id = p.id WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM examination) GROUP BY p.sex;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE p.admission = '-' AND (l.rf = '-' OR l.rf = '+-') AND (l.kct IS NULL OR l.kct = '') AND (l.rvvt IS NULL OR l.rvvt = '') AND (l.lac IS NULL OR l.lac = '')

SELECT p.id, p.diagnosis, MAX(l.dna) AS highest_anti_dna FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE p.diagnosis LIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%' GROUP BY p.id HAVING MAX(l.dna) = (SELECT MAX(dna) FROM laboratory l2 INNER JOIN patient p2 ON l2.id = p2.id WHERE p2.diagnosis LIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%')

SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN p.sex = 'F' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN p.sex = 'M' THEN 1 END)) AS gender_difference FROM patient AS p INNER JOIN laboratory AS l ON l.id = p.id WHERE l.rnp IS NOT NULL AND (l.rnp IS NOT NULL AND l.rnp <> 'negative' AND CAST(l.rnp AS INTEGER) >= 32) AND l.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM laboratory WHERE id = p.id);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31' AND admission LIKE '+';

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(o.oxygen_count), 0), 4) AS average_oxygen_per_molecule FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) FILTER (WHERE a.element = 'O') AS oxygen_count FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id FROM bond AS b WHERE b.bond_type = '-') GROUP BY m.molecule_id) AS o;

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS single_bond_count FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-' GROUP BY m.molecule_id) AS subquery;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li') AND b.bond_type = '-' ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3;

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count FROM atom AS a JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' GROUP BY a.element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, a.element ASC;
